info.title: Headless LMS API
info.description: API documentation for the Headless LMS platform. Every route under /api takes a signed-in session or an API key, sent in the `x-api-key` header or as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The platform routes take the platform key as `Authorization: Bearer <platform key>`.

post.summary: Create an organization and make it active
post.description: For any signed-in person, including one with no organization yet. The caller becomes its owner.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Transfer ownership of the organization
post.description: Owner only. The new owner must be an active member. The previous owner takes the named org role, Member by default. 403 for anyone else, including the owner's API keys.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.description: Requires `roles:read`. Each role with its levels, permissions and the number of people who hold it.

givable.description: Whether the role can be given. False for the owner role, which moves only by transfer.

post.summary: Add a role
post.description: Requires `roles:write`. The role starts from a deployment role (`base`) and needs every permission it holds.

givable.description: Whether the role can be given. False for the owner role, which moves only by transfer.

patch.description: Requires `roles:write`. A rename needs nothing else. Changing permissions, levels or the team flag needs every permission the role holds before and after the change (403 names the missing ones). Owner and Member can only be renamed (409). Names are unique in the organization (409).

givable.description: Whether the role can be given. False for the owner role, which moves only by transfer.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

put.description: Requires `people:write`. Needs every permission the old and the new role hold. Nobody changes their own roles, and the owner's role changes only by transfer.

delete.summary: Remove a person from the organization
delete.description: Requires `people:delete`. Needs every permission the person holds, where they hold it. Revokes their API keys and connected apps here. The owner can't be removed (409); neither can someone whose posts must be kept (409).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Invite a person with an org role
post.description: Requires `people:write`. The person is created by this call, so access and item roles can be given before they accept. Needs every permission the role holds; never `owner` (409).

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Resend a person's pending invite
post.description: Requires `people:write`. Issues a new link; the resender becomes the inviter.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

delete.description: Requires `people:write`. Someone still invited who holds no access and no item role is removed with it.

get.description: Public: no session needed. The same 404 answers forged, expired and accepted tokens, so a probe learns nothing.

post.summary: Accept an invite with the signed-in account
post.description: For any signed-in person whose email matches the invitation. Makes the invite's organization the session's active one. 400 when the token is invalid or expired, the email does not match, or the inviter no longer holds the role.

get.summary: List the notification types a category list can cover
get.description: Requires one of `notification_categories:read`, `communities:read`. `scope=org` lists the types the org list can cover and needs `notification_categories:read`; `scope=community` lists those a community list can cover and also takes `communities:read` on any community. Each type carries all its scopes, so an editor can tell which types can be per space.

get.summary: List the notification channels this deployment can deliver on
get.description: Requires one of `notification_categories:read`, `communities:read`. `communities:read` on any community is enough. `inApp` is always first.

topics.description: The complete list, in order. A topic left out is deleted

get.summary: List the people who hold a community
get.description: Requires `access:read`. Everyone with active access to the community, granted directly or through a bundle, paged and searched by name or email.

team.description: Shown as team in the community.

roleName.description: The name of the role that makes them team in the community, or null.

opensEverySpace.description: Opens every space of the community, so holds no place in its spaces.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: List the members, requests and invitations of a space
get.description: For a person who can open the space. Its members; a holder of `communities:moderate` on the community also sees its open requests to join and open invitations. People who open every space of the community through their role are not listed. 404 when you cannot open the space.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Add a person to a space
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Places a member of the community straight into the space, with no request or invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members, the person is already placed, or the space is full.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Invite a person into a space
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Invites a member of the community into a `by_invite` space; they join when they accept. 403 when the person opens every space or is not a member of the community; 409 when the space is not invite-only or the person is already placed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Approve a person's request to join a space
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Makes the requester an active member. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when the space is full or they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Decline a person's request to join a space
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Closes the open request. 404 when the person has no open request; 409 when they are already a member.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a person from a space
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Revokes the placement, whether it is a membership, a request or an invitation. 409 when the space is open to all members or the placement is already revoked.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

get.summary: The moderation queue of a space
get.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Posts awaiting review, and the open flags on posts and on comments in the space. Each list holds at most the 100 oldest entries: pending posts by creation, flags by when they were raised; working the queue brings in the next ones.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Publish a post that is awaiting review
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. 409 when the post is not awaiting review.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a post
post.description: The author can remove their own post; anyone else needs `communities:moderate` on the community. Takes a published or pending post down; removing someone else's post resolves its open flags as `removed`. 409 when it is already removed or was never submitted.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Restore a removed post
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. 409 when the post is not removed.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a post
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Closes every open flag on the post and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the post up. Removing the post resolves its flags as `removed` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Remove a comment on a post
post.description: The author can remove their own comment; anyone else needs `communities:moderate` on the community. Hides the comment; removing someone else's comment resolves its open flags as `removed`. Removing a removed comment returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Restore a removed comment on a post
post.description: Requires one of `courses:moderate`, `communities:moderate`. Publishes the comment again. Restoring a comment that is not removed returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a comment
post.description: Requires one of `courses:moderate`, `communities:moderate`. Closes every open flag on the comment and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the comment up. Removing the comment resolves its flags as `removed` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Dismiss the open flags on a message
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Closes every open flag on the message and leaves it up.

resolution.description: `dismissed` closes the open flags and leaves the message up. Deleting the message or locking the chat resolves its flags as `deleted` or `locked` instead.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`

post.summary: Unlock a chat
post.description: Requires `communities:moderate`. Lets participants send messages again. Unlocking an unlocked chat returns it unchanged.

path.description: Where in the request, such as `body.topics[1].name`
